name: The 72 Seasons
desc:
The 72 Seasons is a large inn floating through space and time.

There are a total of seven tavern doors scattered across Lumen that can lead to this place. The different doors in the Etrean Luminant are located at:

1.  In front of [Erisia](location:erisia), sailing from [Etris](location:etris), where the tree bandits would be placed around a campfire, on the right.
2.  Near the food stand in the [Isle of Vigils](location:isle_of_vigils), walk behind stand that [Lance's Brother](entity:lances_brother) owns and to the left, continuing further until you're met with a gateway on the side of the rock.
3.  Also in [Isle of Vigils](location:isle_of_vigils), near the [Barber](entity:barber) or Mantra training gear shop. On the right of it would be the gateway.
4.  In [Minityrsa](location:minityrsa), found by going to the shore and hugging the left edge of the island until reaching the area with the downwards zipline to the shore next to another zipline. The door is embedded in a wall next to free snow-capped trees.

With the other doors being placed in the Eastern Luminant are:

1.  In the [Greathive Aratel](location:greathive_aratel), near the Fountain Gates, walk forward until you meet the stairs outside of Greathive. On your left and besides the stairs would be the gateway.
2.  In front of the door to [The Lordsgrove](location:the_lordsgrove) from [Starswept Valley](location:the_starswept_valley). On the right of the door, near the jump pad is the tavern door.
3.  To the left of the log that leads to [Cerulean](entity:cerulean)'s cave.
